visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a tight long-sleeved red shirt and a short black pleated skirt with boots, enters a dimly lit themed cafe. She walks tentatively up a set of stairs decorated with red lanterns and stones, looking nervously at her surroundings. (2) She moves through a series of horror-themed rooms filled with creepy masks, religious effigies, and talismans hanging from the ceiling and walls. The lighting is predominantly warm red and dim, creating a spooky atmosphere. She holds her hands together near her chest, exhibiting signs of fear. (3) The woman is seen in a bathroom area where yellow talismans are pasted onto the mirror. She washes her hands in a white sink while glancing at her reflection with a puzzled expression. (4) She sits at a wooden table in the dining area. A staff member in a black uniform presents various themed dishes, including rice topped with eyeball-like items and black pasta. The woman interacts with the food and talks to the camera, still appearing slightly unsettled but curious. (5) Close-up shots of the themed food are shown, highlighting the intricate and macabre presentation. The woman tastes the food, reacting with a mix of surprise and enjoyment while gesturing toward the dishes. (6) The video concludes with the woman sharing her final thoughts on the experience, smiling at the camera despite the eerie backdrop of masks and dark wood paneling.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the protagonist's footsteps climbing stairs, accompanied by her nervous laughter and high-pitched vocal inflections. A low, eerie synth drone provides a tense musical bed. (2) As she explores the props, a metallic 'clink' is heard when she touches an object. Her voice becomes hushed, exhibiting breathiness and vocal tension. (3) The sound of splashing water marks a transition to the sink scene. Her voice rises in pitch as she expresses confusion. (4) In the dining area, a second female voice (the staff) enters with a calm, professional narrative tone, explaining the food features. The BGM swells slightly with rhythmic percussive hits. (5) Loud chewing and metallic utensil sounds occur as she eats, followed by an excited, high-arousal vocal reaction ('很好吃耶'). (6) The segment ends with a rhythmic chant ('火佛修一...') overlapping with the woman's final casual vlog-style commentary and consistent low-tempo eerie music.
